qa_pairs.question: How do the customs notifications issued by the government under Section 19 of the Customs Act, 1969, facilitate the granting of duty exemptions?
qa_pairs.answer: The government issues customs notifications (SROs) exercising the powers granted under Section 19(1) of the Customs Act, 1969, often in consultation with the National Board of Revenue and in the public interest, to amend, revoke, or establish specific duty exemption frameworks for goods, sometimes in conjunction with the VAT Act of 1991.

qa_pairs.question: Which legal transition is reflected in the recent customs notifications regarding the authority to grant exemptions?
qa_pairs.answer: Recent customs notifications have transitioned from exercising powers under Section 19 of the Customs Act, 1969, to exercising powers under Section 25(1) of the Customs Act, 2023, for granting exemptions in conjunction with the VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012.
